A '''ceremonial shamshir''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] worn by [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Council of Elders (Klatooinian)|Elders]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="LoNH" />
